info.title: ZERODROID
info.author: Zero Data
info.description: Unofficial Boosteroid cloud-gaming client for Nintendo Switch homebrew.
info.details: ZERODROID is an open-source, unofficial Boosteroid cloud-gaming client for Nintendo Switch homebrew. It provides QR device login, a controller-first library, native H.264 video, Opus audio and full Joy-Con/Pro Controller input. v0.8.2 adds system-keyboard search, Favorites and Recently Played tabs, Spanish/English UI, server-region preferences and a live gateway ping meter. It requires a legitimate Boosteroid account and title takeover; Album/applet mode lacks enough memory. ZERODROID contains no games, CFW, DRM bypasses or Nintendo software and is not affiliated with Boosteroid or Nintendo. Application data stays under sdmc:/switch/ZERODROID/.

changelog: v0.8.2 adds native library search, All/Favorites/Recently Played tabs, persistent favorites and a 30-game recent history, plus a Spanish/English selector. The beta also includes QR login, preferred server/region settings, H.264/Opus streaming, a live ping display, Nintendo/Xbox button layouts, Guide/Home input and in-stream touch settings.
